review_scope: Corrected revision of a new article, resubmitted after the second independent review requested rework on three textual claims only. title_options: Agent Memory Multi-Hop Recall: One Retrieval Misses Half of a Two-Hop Answer
Two-Hop Questions Break Local Agent Memory: the Bridge Fact Ranks Below Top-5
Local Agent Memory: When Both Facts Do Not Fit in Top-5
presentation.title_rationale: The selected title puts the topic (agent memory multi-hop recall) and the reader's problem first, then promises the one thing the fixture measures: a single retrieval carries only half of a two-hop answer, which is the measured 3-5 of 20 coverage at k=5, not a claim about all multi-hop systems. Fixture size, encoders and the year moved into the introduction.
presentation.visual_purpose: Two-lane conceptual diagram. Lane A carries the measured single-shot top-5 shape (the bridge ranks below the cut, so one of the two facts arrives). Lane B carries the iterative split - retrieve hop 1, put the intermediate entity into a second query - and is explicitly labelled as not measured in this run, because the measured one-shot decomposition named the intermediate entity in 0 of 20 rewrites and covered both facts in 4 of 20. It carries no numbers, so its scope is retrieval shape only and it cannot be read as a result.
